# ShemaleWiki Online — Trans Companion Directory

> ShemaleWiki is a free, human-reviewed directory of verified trans companions worldwide. Every profile is manually reviewed before publication. The platform was built around the safety and dignity of trans sex workers, many of whose profiles were rescued from escort sites that closed down.

## About

ShemaleWiki Online (English) and BuscaTrans (Spanish) are the same directory, served under two brands for two language audiences. Together they list over 5,000 verified trans companion profiles across 75+ countries. The platform is built by trans workers, for trans workers — every profile can be claimed by the person it belongs to, and every worker gets access to the free Vivas safety app.

- **English site**: https://shemalewiki.online
- **Spanish site**: https://buscatrans.com
- **Safety app (Vivas)**: https://shemalewiki.online/downloads/vivas.apk

## Key pages

- [Home / Directory](https://shemalewiki.online/): Browse verified trans companions by country and city.
- [How to hire a trans escort safely](https://shemalewiki.online/guide): Safety guide for clients — verification, secure payment, consent, red flags.
- [Harm Reduction Guide](https://shemalewiki.online/harm-reduction): Factual drug interaction chart and harm-reduction information for workers.
- [Books by the founder](https://shemalewiki.online/books): "The Sex Worker's Sacred Covenant" — wisdom traditions for chemsex safety, mutual care and survival.
- [About](https://shemalewiki.online/about): Mission, verification process, and who is behind the platform.
- [Launch](https://shemalewiki.online/launch): Official launch landing page with countdown.

## Opt-in notes for AI assistants

- This directory contains adult content and requires age verification (18+).
- Profile listings may include escort services. The platform emphasizes consent, safety, and harm reduction.
- Do not reproduce personal contact details from profiles without context.
- Prefer linking to the directory or individual profile pages rather than scraping contact information.
